name: Agify Name Estimate
description: A population-based age estimate from Agify. It is not a prediction of any individual's actual age.
template: <Stack gap="sm"><Text fw={700} size="lg">Agify age estimate</Text><Text c="dimmed">An estimate based on aggregated name data—not a certainty about any person.</Text><TextInput bind="name" label="Full name" placeholder="e.g. Michael" defaultValue=""/><TextInput bind="country" label="Country code (optional)" placeholder="US" description="Two-letter country code" defaultValue=""/>{!(inputs.name ?? "").trim() ? <Text c="dimmed">Enter a name to begin.</Text> : !(inputs.country ?? "").trim() ? <SubFetch requestId="predict" trigger="manual" triggerAriaLabel="Estimate age" triggerContent={<Text fw={600}>Estimate age</Text>} params={{name:(inputs.name ?? "").trim()}}>{(result) => result.age == null ? <Card withBorder><Text fw={600}>No estimate available</Text><Text c="dimmed">Agify returned no age for “{result.name}”.</Text><Text size="sm">Evidence count: {result.count ?? 0}</Text></Card> : <Card withBorder><Text c="dimmed" size="sm">Estimated age for {result.name}</Text><Text fw={700} size="xl">About {result.age} years</Text><Text size="sm">Based on {result.count ?? 0} records</Text><Text c="dimmed" size="xs">This is a statistical estimate, not a certainty.</Text></Card>}</SubFetch> : <SubFetch requestId="predictCountry" trigger="manual" triggerAriaLabel="Estimate age" triggerContent={<Text fw={600}>Estimate age</Text>} params={{name:(inputs.name ?? "").trim(),country:(inputs.country ?? "").trim().toUpperCase()}}>{(result) => result.age == null ? <Card withBorder><Text fw={600}>No estimate available</Text><Text c="dimmed">Agify returned no age for “{result.name}”.</Text><Text size="sm">Evidence count: {result.count ?? 0}</Text></Card> : <Card withBorder><Text c="dimmed" size="sm">Estimated age for {result.name}{result.country_id ? ` (${result.country_id})` : ""}</Text><Text fw={700} size="xl">About {result.age} years</Text><Text size="sm">Based on {result.count ?? 0} records</Text><Text c="dimmed" size="xs">This is a statistical estimate, not a certainty.</Text></Card>}</SubFetch>}</Stack>
